symptom: checkout-api is slow during traffic spikes and should scale out, but it stays at one replica no matter the load.
root_cause: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler checkout-api cannot compute CPU utilization: the log-shipper container has no CPU request, so the metric is missing (FailedGetResourceMetric) and it never scales.
must: cpu request|request for cpu|missing request|no cpu request|without a cpu|cpu.{0,30}(request|unknown)
